areas.name: Delegating
areas.short: Handing over real ownership, not just tasks.
areas.text: You may free up your time and build trust by letting others own outcomes.

areas.name: Handling conflict
areas.short: Raising and working through disagreement constructively.
areas.text: You may help a team deal with tension early, before it grows.

areas.name: Strategic thinking
areas.short: Looking ahead and connecting today's work to a longer-term direction.
areas.text: You may naturally help a team see why its work matters and where it is heading.

areas.name: Collaborating
areas.short: Shaping plans and decisions together with the people involved.
areas.text: You may build commitment by involving people early and sharing ownership.

areas.name: Making decisions
areas.short: Making and explaining choices, especially under uncertainty.
areas.text: You may help a team move forward by making clear, explained calls.

areas.name: Communicating
areas.short: Keeping people informed and checking understanding.
areas.text: You may keep people aligned by sharing information early and clearly.

areas.name: Developing the team
areas.short: Building how a team works together and learns.
areas.text: You may enjoy shaping a team's habits, welcome and ways of learning.

areas.name: Planning and organising
areas.short: Turning goals into plans, owners and dates, and keeping them on track.
areas.text: Writing down milestones and owners for one goal could make progress easier to see.

areas.name: Coaching others
areas.short: Helping people grow by asking, listening and supporting stretch.
areas.text: Swapping one piece of advice for one good question could help others grow faster.

leadership.note: These are preferences: the parts of leading you enjoy most and least today. They are not abilities, they change with experience, and they must never be used to select, promote or rate anyone.

recommended_modules.summary: Hand over ownership, not just tasks, and agree how you will stay in touch.
recommended_modules.title: Delegating well

recommended_modules.summary: Turn goals into milestones, owners and dates, and adjust as things change.
recommended_modules.title: Plans that work

recommended_modules.summary: Help people find their own answers and grow through stretch.
recommended_modules.title: Coaching conversations

methodology.band_note: Leadership areas are ranked against each other, not placed in bands.
limitations: This is an original reflection questionnaire. It has not been scientifically validated and has no norms.
Scores show which leadership activities you enjoy most and least today, compared only with each other. They are not abilities and they change with experience.
Leadership preferences must never be used to hire, promote, rate or select anyone.
references: Original questionnaire written for PersonalityDNA AI. It has not been validated and has no norms.
methodology.scoring_summary: Each answer is scored 1 to 5. Each area's score is the average of its three statements, shown on a 0-100 scale where 0 means every answer was 'Not at all' and 100 means every answer was 'Very much'. Areas are ranked against each other; ties keep a fixed order.
